[[File:Feyenoord_tegen_Volendam_3-0,_Van_Deinsen_scoort_2-0,_Bestanddeelnr_929-4355.jpg | thumb | right | Feyenoord vs. Volendam (November 1977)]]
The Dutch '''[[Eredivisie]] in the 1977–78 season''' was contested by 18 teams. [[PSV Eindhoven|PSV]] won the championship and also won the [[1977-78 UEFA Cup|UEFA Cup]] that season to complete a [[Double (association football)|Double]].
